newsitem.title: GREECE: DIMITRAKOPOULOS TO HEAD FX AT ATHENS MONEY BROKERS.
newsitem.headline: DIMITRAKOPOULOS TO HEAD FX AT ATHENS MONEY BROKERS.

text.p: Evangelos Dimitrakopoulos, formerly a senior forex dealer with Sigma Money Brokers has joined Athens Money Brokers and will head its forex desk.
Dimitrakopoulos, 31, is a graduate of the Polytechnic of Wales in finance.

Athens Money Brokers, the third local money brokerage, started operations in July. It is active in forex, forwards, swaps, depos and bonds and is headed by Anastasios Petroutsas, a former treasurer at Citibank- Athens and Panagiotis Speliotopoulos, a senior money broker.
The firm's official opening is scheduled for early September.
